title: Slack: channel posts, rate limits, escaping and reader DMs
description:
**Milestone:** Later, coarse

**Goal.** Coarse until M3 ships. Delivery through the `Channel` interface.

**Build.**
FIFO SQS with message group per channel, because Slack allows about one message per second per channel with short bursts. On 429 wait for `Retry-After`; other workspaces and methods are unaffected. Escape `&`, `<`, `>` in every title and reader text before building mrkdwn, so `<!channel>`, `<!here>` and `<@U...>` cannot be formed from a headline; use `plain_text` where blocks allow, `link_names` off. Test with hostile headlines. Reader DMs: pass the user id as `channel`; Slack answers `channel_not_found` if the app cannot reach them, which in practice means the reader's workspace must have the app installed, so the page must say so. Requires Google sign-in (settled), which needs the site registered as public-reader in Prospectus: today Shipped and Machines on Machines.

**Acceptance.**
Spec'd when started: a headline `<!channel> hi` shows literally and pings nobody.

**Depends on:** kanbus-ae4094, kanbus-726078
